viewer: Buyers in 2026 whose mortgage payment would take 35% of gross pay, counting on raises to make it comfortable.
decision: Stretch to the house at 35% of pay, or buy a cheaper one at 28%?
promise: Using decades of pay history, we measure how long raises have actually taken to shrink a fixed payment from 35% to 28% of pay.
title: Stretching to 35% of Your Pay: How Long Until It's 28%?
thumbnail: Mortgage bill pinned under a paycheck with a stretched rubber band / "35% to 28%?"
